about: Balance provisions (RD-207 item 5): one entry a pairing. "decks" names the two decks; "starts" gives what each deck starts with, by deck name, in the scenario's own keys (homefront, isr, marker, bases as [{supply, damage, devastated}], frontline, rear); "first" names the deck that goes first, or is "" to leave it to the Play screen; "words" is the one sentence printed for the player.

The page uses an entry only when its "in_force" is true; every other entry is ignored. The three entries below are in force: each was found and confirmed by bot games on the trial's third and fifth versions (docs/plans/Sprint_8_Third_Version_Measured_v0.1.md; docs/plans/Sprint_8_Fifth_Version_Measured_v0.1.md). A marker is counted from that deck's own end (Zone 1 is its home Zone).

To put a provision in: edit the entry's numbers and words and set "in_force": true (or add a new entry the same way). Skirmish and watched games use it whichever seat each deck is in; the missions and Basic Training never do.

provisions.words: SPEARHEAD starts with one ARMING STATION from its deck already in its Rear Area, face up and Ready.
SPECTRUM starts with 6 ISR and one LISTENING POST from its deck already in its Rear Area, face up and Ready.
